/// The day of the month [moment] falls on, on the calendar of the machine
/// that runs this. That is the mistake: the answer depends on where the
/// machine is.
int dayHere(DateTime moment) => moment.toLocal().day;

/// The day of the month [moment] falls on, [offset] away from UTC. The
/// offset is an input, so the answer is the same everywhere.
int dayAt(DateTime moment, Duration offset) => moment.toUtc().add(offset).day;
